svg.title: Core Engineering Concepts
svg.desc: Software Engineering: REST API Design, Controller → Service → Repository, Authentication & Authorization, JWT / OAuth2 / RBAC, Multi-Tenant Architecture, Database Design, ORM, Docker / CI-CD, AWS / Cloud Fundamentals; AI Engineering: Embeddings / Vector Search, RAG, Query Rewriting, Context Management, Tool Calling, Agentic Workflows, Memory, Reflection / Validation, LLM Observability, Evaluation; Computer Science: Data Structures & Algorithms, Object Oriented Programming, DBMS/SQL, Operating System, Computer Networking, Problem Solving in C++
